visibility_correction.finding: The historical input-freeze statement candidate_sensitive_gold_truth_or_eligibility_fields_present=false is too broad: the experimental manifest contains assessor/runner metadata including stratum, mode and generated nullity. It contains no Gold configuration or target, but it is not a candidate payload.
visibility_correction.superseding_boundary: The sole mechanism capability is S4CandidateInput. Its S4BlackBoxOracle physically contains only dimension, residual dimension, declared C2 capability, residual callback and target callback; it has no id, family, metamorphic group, stratum, mode, generated nullity, parameter, Gold or analytic-derivative field.
visibility_correction.runner_rule: The runner and Gold-side assessor may read the manifest. Candidate and analytic numerical maps receive only S4CandidateInput; only the separately coded control additionally receives S4AnalyticControlOracle.

execution_fairness.warmup: Before official rows, run unmeasured family-disjoint componentwise-quadratic fixtures at nullity 1, 2 and 4. Rotate which of S1, candidate and analytic control runs first. Persist only fixture namespace, order and status, never elapsed timing.
execution_fairness.official_order: Within each three-representation metamorphic group, use a three-order Latin rotation so every variant occupies every position once; reverse orientation on alternating groups. Persist and independently verify every case order.
execution_fairness.jit_claim: Official efficacy and fail-closed decisions are not intentionally assigned first-use JIT cost to one variant. No performance-speedup claim is made from S4 development wall times.

deadline_boundary.enforcement: Check the ledger before and after each black-box callback, after each generic SVD/projected solve, and capture one checked timestamp for promotion evidence.
deadline_boundary.trusted_fixture_scope: Development callbacks are frozen, local, pure polynomial fixtures. In-process checks cannot preempt a callback or factorization that never returns.
deadline_boundary.forbidden_claim: S4 development does not establish an adversarial OS-enforced ten-second hard wall. Product hard-wall claims require worker-process isolation and an external kill deadline.

runtime_and_archive_chain.runtime: Require Julia 1.12.6, one Julia thread, one BLAS thread, exact Project/Manifest hashes and exact frozen options.
runtime_and_archive_chain.resume: A resume requires byte-bound run identity and warm-up artifacts. Every checkpoint binds source/input/runtime/warm-up hashes, case identity/checksum, exact execution indices and the frozen variant order.
runtime_and_archive_chain.archive: After 36 checkpoints, write a SHA-256 checkpoint manifest. Independently replay every checkpoint row into raw.json and bind checkpoint manifest, raw, summary, environment and report hashes.
runtime_and_archive_chain.mechanical_analysis: Reconstruct route/rank/projected/counter/transport/order/null/residual/error/root/semantic/work operands from persisted fields and re-check Gold, source, runtime and archive bindings.
